summary.intent: Coordinate the construct-suite and checker-lane CI work: land a CI checker lane (ADR 0026 gate) and ensure the construct-suite CI job from PR #389 is actually enforced on main.
summary.outcome: Discovered #389's changes were stranded on feat/construct-suite and never reached main; opened PR #398 to land them and PR #397 for the checker lane (both CI pending). Recommended merge order #398 then #397; the ADR 0026 no-regression gate is not yet met.

repo: Stacked PRs: #389 was stacked on feat/construct-suite; when parent #387 merged without the branch being deleted, GitHub did not retarget #389, so its merge landed in the old branch and main never received the construct-suite job, `just test-construct` recipe, or skip-to-fail guard.
Linking a stranded branch to an Entire trail (#259) causes Entire to open a draft PR to main.

Checker lane: `apps/oracle/construct-suite/checker-expectations.json` holds 212 rows (203 green, 9 documented gaps); run logic is in `src/construct-checker-run.ts`, binary selection in `src/tsrs-bin.ts`, test in `tests/construct-checker-lane.test.ts`.

`just test-checker-lane` builds the release binary with --locked and runs construct:check, construct:parity, the lane and its test with REQUIRE_TSRS=1 REQUIRE_CALIPER_BIN=1; it uses the native binary resolved by the tsrs package's lib/getExePath.js rather than the bin/tsrs Node shim.
react/13, react/29 and react/34 are green on the structural path but gap on the checker path, so ADR 0026's no-regression gate is unmet; 25 rows improved over structural.
The new `Test / Checker lane` CI job does a second cold release build (~1 min locally) and shares no artifact with other jobs; #397 and #398 will conflict trivially in the `needs:` list of ci.yml.
workflow: Verify that stacked PR content actually reached main after merge rather than trusting the 'merged' status.
After a parent PR merges, delete its branch or retarget the child before merging the child.
Subagent reports can surface gaps in earlier claims; independently verify them before acting on them.
Mutation checks (flipping expectations, bogus TSRS_BIN) are used to prove the lane fails rather than skips.

friction: The classifier denied deleting the parent branch feat/construct-suite after #387 merged, which caused the stranding.
The assistant had earlier told the user the 204-row gate was enforced in CI when it was not.
Linux behavior of the checker lane is untested until CI runs; the REQUIRE_CALIPER_BIN missing-binary case was not exercised.
open_items: Get CI green and approvals for #398 then #397, merging in that order.
Delete the old branch with `git push origin --delete feat/construct-suite` after #398 merges.
Finish the memo fix (perf/converter-memo), then slice 3 stacked on it to close the react/13, 29 and 34 regressions.
Resolve the 9 documented checker gaps (objects/23, objects/36, react/03, 04, 05, 07, 13, 29, 34).
Confirm Linux behavior (glibc/musl package choice, lockfile, executable bit) and time the extra cold build once CI runs.
Existing SC2086 finding in weekly.yml remains.
